mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, it is 66 degrees with partly cloudy skies near the Verona Area High School. Tonight, keep your eyes on the Southwest over Mount Horeb at 9:05 PM to catch a two-minute glimpse of the International Space Station as it travels toward the East Northeast.

The City of Verona reports that phase two of the Highway M construction project begins the week of September 7, causing traffic shifts and lane changes. Additionally, the Verona Police Department announced the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson following an investigation into an incident reported on Sunday, August 30.

You have plenty to choose from this week. Yoga is available today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. On Wednesday, check out the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park or join a trivia night at The Mill, Paddy Mac's, or The Bogey Factory.
The Verona Police Department is currently investigating a case involving a school staff member, with the incident reported to authorities on Sunday, August 30.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
